comment: THE LENS (05-Sep-2026): how a cunning team reads a company before it writes a page. A lens is chosen from what the posting says (cues), and it decides what LEADS: which projects rank up (leadRe against title/summary/tags), the angle the wording is re-aimed to (framing), the section order, and how loud the skills rows are. Data, not code — add a lens for a new kind of company by adding an object here. The brain (Gemini) sees this catalogue and may keep or change the choice; the keyless floor applies it deterministically.

lenses.label: proof of mind
lenses.framing: lead with the problem understood and the innovation, and with how the work was verified — proof of reasoning and agency, not a tool list
lenses.why: the posting is about the mind, not the stack — boards, NTSE, innovation and self-directed shipping carry the page

lenses.label: social impact
lenses.framing: lead with who it serves and what changed for them, in plain words; name the AI once as the means, never as the point; keep every number that describes people reached, cost, or time saved
lenses.why: they hire for the people served — Braillix and Sehat Saarthi are stronger than any AI system here, and volunteering is evidence, not filler

lenses.label: product & growth
lenses.framing: lead with what shipped, who uses it and the measurable outcome — ownership of a result end to end, decisions named, numbers first
lenses.why: they read for outcomes and ownership — the page opens on shipped results with numbers, the stack rides behind

lenses.label: research rigour
lenses.framing: lead with the question, the method and the measured result; name the verification and the limits honestly — rigour is the proof
lenses.why: a research reader checks method and honesty first — measured results, the position paper and verification lines carry the page

lenses.label: founder, ships
lenses.framing: lead with what shipped and how fast, end to end and alone where true; the reader is a founder who counts what is live
lenses.why: a founder reads for shipped, live, owned — projects first, proof of speed and ownership

lenses.label: AI engineering
lenses.framing: lead with the system built and the engineering decision inside it — the model, the pipeline, the evaluation — and the number that proves it works
lenses.why: an AI-engineering reader scans stack and systems first — the technical proof leads, assembled for their asks
